definitions: A person, often a law enforcement officer or fire department official, who specializes in determining the origin and cause of fires, particularly those suspected to be intentionally set.
An expert responsible for gathering evidence at fire scenes to ascertain whether a fire was accidental or a result of arson.
examples: The arson investigator examined the debris.
An arson investigator was called to the scene.
She works as an arson investigator for the city.
